human_text: A student in normal academic standing may register for between 16 and 26 credits per regular semester. Students with CGPA >= 8.50 may overload up to 30 credits with Faculty Advisor approval.
Students on academic probation or with CGPA below 6.00 are restricted to a reduced credit cap of 18 credits to facilitate backlog clearance.
Students with CGPA >= 8.00 at the end of the 4th semester are eligible to enroll in an academic Minor (18 credits completed between Sem V and Sem VIII).
A maximum of 12 credits earned through approved 8-week or 12-week NPTEL/SWAYAM courses may be transferred towards Open / Free Electives upon approval.
